name: carrier_open
title: How a transport-v2 connection opens
summary: The client first behaves like a browser: a browser-shaped TLS handshake, the cover page and its assets, then a WebSocket request carrying an admission token. Only a valid, unused token reaches AUTH. Everything else stays on the cover path.
comment: Transport v2 only. docs/STEALTH.md and docs/protocol/YUME_2_0_WIRE.md own the exact behavior.
The rejected-request residual (bounded 404 versus the reference 405) must stay stated while it exists.

nodes.title: TLS 1.3 HANDSHAKE
nodes.note: The client opens TLS 1.3 to yumed with a ClientHello reproduced from one captured browser profile, through an opt-in capability in YUME's pinned OpenSSL build.

nodes.title: PAGE AND ASSETS
nodes.note: Before any tunnel request, the client loads the captured cover page and its assets on the same HTTP/2 connection, like a first visit to the site.

nodes.title: TUNNEL REQUEST
nodes.note: An RFC 8441 extended CONNECT opens a WebSocket stream. Its path carries an admission token: an HMAC over the transport version, the profile, the site name, the hour and a fresh nonce.

nodes.title: ADMISSION CHECK
nodes.note: yumed recomputes the token for the current or previous hour, checks that the TLS site name and the HTTP/2 authority agree, and records the nonce in a process-wide replay cache of at most 4,096 entries.

nodes.title: AUTH V2
nodes.note: This is the first YUME message. The server's challenge carries fresh public keys, the client proves its Ed25519 + ML-DSA-87 identity, and both sides derive a root key bound to this TLS connection.

nodes.title: SEALED STREAMS
nodes.note: AUTH_OK arrives already sealed. From then on every message has a one-use AES-256-GCM key and travels as a WebSocket binary message inside HTTP/2 DATA frames.

nodes.title: COVER PATH
nodes.note: Missing, wrong, expired, replayed or mismatched tokens never receive AUTH. The rejected tunnel request gets a bounded 404, which differs from the reference cover server, while page requests still reach the cover site.
